data.title: [Pristine Monthly Pass Tribute] Tribute Event
data.brief: ▼// Event TimeAfter [At the Wake of Spring] version release – May 18, 2026 at 04:00 (server time)※ A
data.data:
▼// Event Time

After [At the Wake of Spring] version release – May 18, 2026 at 04:00 (server time)

※ Asia Server Time Zone: UTC+8

※ Americas / Europe Server Time Zone: UTC-5


▼// Event Rewards

During the event, you can receive up to [Oroberyl]×6000, [Emergency Sanity Booster]×30, and [Sanity Usage Permit]×120.


▼// Participation Requirements

Complete the main mission [Chapter I Process I: Break the Siege]


▼// Event Details

· Log in every day during the event to receive [Oroberyl]×200, [Emergency Sanity Booster]×1, and [Sanity Usage Permit]×4.

· Daily event rewards are refreshed daily at 04:00 (server time). Rewards not claimed that day due to not logging into the game will not be reissued. Please remember to log in and claim your rewards in time, Endministrator.

· The [Pristine Monthly Pass Tribute] and [Monthly Pass] can both be active at the same time, and their claim counts are tracked separately. During the event, the [Pristine Monthly Pass Tribute] daily login rewards can be claimed up to 30 times in total.


※ For more event details, check the in-game [Event Center].
